notes: The page first characterizes q by an orientation-reversing involution, computes the change of sigma_t under t -> tg, and states odd/even corollaries. The left note discusses opposite generators and a canonical order-two element. The lower parenthesis introduces a fiber product of sets, the group version, kernels and surjectivity.

Underlined internal labels are Corollaire, NB, Sommet, opposé and Parenthèse. There is no date and no authorial manuscript page number. The bottom-left 11 is represented only by an archive comment and inventoried as an unnamed hand.

All 21 original C doubts are explicitly mapped by the findings C01 through C21. Nine are resolved and twelve retained. The reading has six new uncertainties: the opening separator, opening article, marginal shorthand, and three independently compressed lower group nouns. There are no nested C doubts on this page.
S.json is an empty array, so there are no S decisions. There is no H_drawings supplement in the packet. H editorial page headings and notes are not transcribed as manuscript text.

Two independently written closing parentheses after bijectif are retained without supplying opening parentheses. The map strokes remain headless. These graphic decisions were not selected by mathematical syntax.
The detached mark above Solution is copied as a drawing. Its purpose is not assigned; a lexical s reading is not asserted.
There are no explicit authorial doubt words or question marks securely read on this page. Mon is retained literally and is not silently expanded to an instruction.

Only the specified whole image and two halves were viewed, each once. Eighteen distinct enhanced crops were made and viewed once. No OCR, text recognition, PDF extraction, web research, external witness, other scan or other reader file was used.
